standard_prerequisites.name: The circle code family
standard_prerequisites.statement: The code family assigns to each point of the circle a type, with the integers at the base point, and decode turns an element of the code into a path from the point to the base point.
standard_prerequisites.use: They are the two maps composed in the statement.

standard_prerequisites.name: Induction on the integers
standard_prerequisites.statement: A type family over the integers with a point at zero and steps in both directions has a section.
standard_prerequisites.use: It is the induction that runs the main computation.

standard_prerequisites.name: Transport along the generating loop adds one
standard_prerequisites.statement: Transporting in the code family along the generating loop adds one to the integer, as computed for the circle code.
standard_prerequisites.use: It is the step that turns the transport chain into arithmetic.

core_obligations: Prove the identity by circle induction, noting that the loop case is a path between paths in the integers and hence immediate because the integers are a set (source lines 597-601).
Reduce the base case to the statement that encoding the n-fold loop gives n for every integer n (source lines 603-605).

Settle the case of zero by definition and the successor case by a five-line computation that unwinds the definition of the loop powers, the definition of encode, functoriality of transport and the transport computation along the generating loop (source lines 608-617).
Note that the negative case is analogous, which closes the induction (source line 619).

proof_roadmap.step: Circle induction, reduce to the base case at the integers.
Successor case: unwind the transport chain into arithmetic.

difficulty_reason: Counted unit is the author labelled lemma at source lines 591-594 (book Lemma 8.1.8): for every point x of the circle and every element c of its code, encoding the decode of c returns c. The statement is an identity between composites and gives no computation, and the proof (source lines 596-623) has to run a circle induction whose loop case is dismissed only because the integers are a set, then reduce the base case to an arithmetic identity about loop powers, which is settled by induction on the integers with a successor step that unwinds the definition of the loop powers, the definition of encode, functoriality of transport and the transport computation along the generating loop. Which of these four rewrites supplies which factor of the final arithmetic is exactly the content, and none of it is visible in the statement.
